Disable every live user recurrence admission/resume/drain path before applying retirement; recheck live claims and financial unknown outcomes, then soft retire eligible definitions without purging historical tables or keys.
Verify OAuth and hosted catalogs347/126, manual operation/delivery/billing/auth behavior, retired APIs/UI absence, ordinary connections, independent templates and assistant takeovers.
Verify official SDK 5 packages / 7 archives, hosted MCPB/website REST/docs/guide/Xray projections and fresh configured CodexNPX process.
Update progressive candidate states with exact live receipts and rerun existing matrix validator in publish phase; no final completion claim while live proof is pending.
notes: Every prior known surface is retained; old scheduler rows are evidenced migrations rather than omitted.

All four hosted units, three public Memory packages, legacy compatibility CLI and five SDK packages are directly changed or in the proven contract closure. Nango/Modal functions are verify_only; no unaffected provider is rebuilt or republished.

Internal maintenance/recovery, manual jobs, pagination/retries, credentials, historical financial records and unrelated products are retained. PAA checks remain 20 seconds; this release does not prove new live PAA acquisition quality or a completion-time promise.
No framework added, key rotation, historical data purge, source-map secrecy claim or new custom verification machinery.
